dependency_snapshot.readiness_rule: O-SURFACE-PROMETEO_MOBILE-LOCAL-INTEGRATE-V1 may be claimed only after all nine declared dependencies have an exact durable RETURN plus matching terminal DONE and the integration claim is still absent.

north_star: One correction/request inside the existing Universal Host should be enough to create durable scoped work, produce candidate evidence, reconcile it locally and surface the result back in the same host/page thread without making the human a scheduler, courier or merger.

actions: Pin Universal Host V5 as the existing served host identity.
Pin Served-manifest digest authority over filename/path inference.
Preserve safe-area/resize/rotation/tactile behavior unless falsified by concrete evidence.
Preserve page-scoped Change Threads and host-routed result identity.
Keep absent mobile-only product/gesture/breakpoint literals as SOURCE_DEBT.

sublanes.goal: Trace one page-scoped correction through deterministic bridge identity, claim, STARTED, candidate work, RETURN/DONE, steward disposition and same-surface visible result without losing page/change identity.
Prove raw private literal/audio/file/transcript payload does not enter public coordination while reopenable sanitized lineage remains sufficient.
Prove repeated equivalent correction fingerprints deterministically and concurrent workers cannot create duplicate ownership or double-start the same exclusive opportunity.
Prove RETURN remains candidate evidence until a separate authorized disposition/promotion step; tests never imply Human Accepted or Served.
Preserve explicit CURRENT_GRAPH/Served-manifest authority differences rather than silently reconciling them.

campaign.parallelism_rule: These checks are logically independent and may run in parallel under isolated/read-only scopes; shared integration remains serialized through the local Steward candidate.

flow: human emits one correction/request in the same surface/page context
page Change Thread captures the request privately
Page Thread Bridge emits sanitized deterministic work identity without inventing page_id
allocator derives/claims scoped work with collision-safe ownership
worker persists STARTED before substantive work
worker produces candidate artifact/evidence and immutable RETURN then matching DONE
Local Steward dispositions returns, preserves conflicts and requests independent verification when required
same Universal Host/page thread receives a concise derived state/result projection
full claim/run/return/steward lineage remains durable underneath the concise human-facing projection
campaign.human_burden_target: one correction/request plus a real acceptance decision only when authority/product judgment is actually needed

Emit one local integration candidate plus exact verification requirements.

campaign.rule: Module/unit receipts for bridge or steward do not prove browser/device acceptance. Any candidate touching served host behavior must pass the existing promotion/browser/device gates appropriate to its actual mutation scope.

acceptance_gates: No second mobile shell/app/page identity is introduced without explicit authoritative evidence.
One correction retains causal page/change identity through durable work and visible result.
Private human payload does not leak into public coordination.
Equivalent work deduplicates deterministically and exclusive claim collisions fail safely.
Every completion visible to integration is reconstructable from exact durable RETURN+matching DONE evidence.
Local Steward preserves conflicts and protected authority boundaries rather than newest-wins.
Served-manifest authority and registry mismatches remain explicit.
Module receipts are not mislabeled as browser/device or Human Acceptance evidence.

deduplication.reason: Current discovery/risk evidence says the highest-value frontier is lifecycle completion and local reconciliation. Creating parallel mobile build tickets before the prepared integration gate would duplicate ownership or invent unsourced design work.

non_obvious_findings: The original stale planner already had the correct structural premise: mobile is context over one host. Its failure was lifecycle completion and stale evidence fan-in, not necessarily planning shape.

The UX blocker changed while the stale planner slept: Page Thread Bridge later acquired candidate RETURN evidence, so recovery must reconcile chronology rather than freeze an earlier audit conclusion.
The next integration should spend effort proving causal identity/privacy/dedup/authority continuity, not creating a visually distinct mobile product.
remaining_boundaries: REUSE was active/unresolved at this planning snapshot.
This worker did not execute browser/device validation.
This worker did not mutate served product bytes.
This worker did not promote Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.
